parameters.name: SMA Trend (50D/200D)
parameters.description: Price position relative to the 50-day and 200-day simple moving averages, and their relative order (golden cross vs. death cross regime).

rubric.condition: Price above both 50D and 200D SMA, and 50D SMA above 200D SMA (golden cross regime)
Mixed signal — price above one MA but not the other, or MAs converging/flat
Price below both 50D and 200D SMA, and 50D SMA below 200D SMA (death cross regime)

parameters.name: MACD Signal
parameters.description: MACD line vs. signal line, and direction of the most recent crossover.

rubric.condition: MACD line above signal line and rising (recent bullish crossover, widening)
MACD/signal converging, flat, or crossed within the last few sessions with no clear follow-through
MACD line below signal line and falling (recent bearish crossover, widening)

parameters.name: Volume Trend
parameters.description: 20-day average volume trend relative to price direction (accumulation vs. distribution).

rubric.condition: Rising volume concentrated on up days / above-average volume with price advancing (accumulation)
Volume roughly flat or mixed relative to price direction
Rising volume concentrated on down days / above-average volume with price declining (distribution)

parameters.name: 52-Week Range Position
parameters.description: Current price as a percentile of the 52-week high/low range.

rubric.condition: Top quartile of 52-week range (> 80th percentile), i.e. near 52-week highs with relative strength
Middle of 52-week range (20th-80th percentile)
Bottom quartile of 52-week range (< 20th percentile), i.e. near 52-week lows

parameters.name: P/E vs. Sector/Historical
parameters.description: Trailing P/E compared to sector median and the stock's own 5-year average. If P/E is not meaningful (negative earnings), substitute P/S and note the substitution.

rubric.condition: P/E below both sector median and own 5-year average (undervalued on both bases)
P/E within ~15% of sector median and/or historical average
P/E above both sector median and own 5-year average by more than ~15% (overvalued on both bases)

parameters.name: Revenue Growth YoY
parameters.description: Most recent quarter or TTM revenue growth, year-over-year.

rubric.condition: Negative

parameters.name: Profit Margin Trend
parameters.description: Operating or net margin trend over the trailing several quarters.

rubric.condition: Expanding by more than ~1 point YoY
Roughly flat (within ±1 point)
Contracting by more than ~1 point YoY

parameters.name: Debt-to-Equity
parameters.description: Total debt to shareholder equity. Sector context matters (e.g. capital-intensive or financial-services names run structurally higher) — note sector norms rather than scoring blind.

rubric.condition: < 0.5x (conservative leverage)
0.5x - 1.5x (moderate leverage)
> 1.5x (elevated leverage)

parameters.name: FCF / EPS Growth
parameters.description: Free cash flow trend combined with EPS growth YoY.

rubric.condition: Positive FCF and EPS growth > 10% YoY
Positive FCF, EPS growth flat to 10%
Negative or declining FCF, or negative EPS growth

parameters.name: Analyst Consensus & Price Target
parameters.description: Aggregate analyst rating and average price target vs. current price.

rubric.condition: Consensus Buy/Strong Buy and average price target > 10% above current price
Consensus Hold, or price target within ±10% of current price
Consensus Sell/Underweight, or average price target > 10% below current price

parameters.name: Recent News Sentiment
parameters.description: Tone of the 2-3 most significant news items in the trailing 2-4 weeks (earnings, guidance, product, legal/regulatory, management changes).

rubric.condition: Predominantly positive coverage (beats, raised guidance, favorable product/legal news)
Mixed or neutral coverage
Predominantly negative coverage (misses, cut guidance, litigation, adverse headlines)

parameters.name: Short Interest
parameters.description: Short interest as a percentage of float. Note in output if elevated short interest could also signal squeeze risk rather than pure bearishness.

rubric.condition: < 3% of float
3% - 10% of float
> 10% of float

parameters.name: Insider Activity
parameters.description: Net insider buying/selling over the trailing 3 months.

rubric.condition: Net insider buying
Minimal or no net insider transactions
Net insider selling, especially by multiple executives

decision_logic.description: Overall score combined with current position state (from input State column) determines the decision label.
